payload.interpretation: Retrospective development after E022/E026/E029 results were known. Two fixed pretrained variants; duplicate eligible observed past target as named covariate, then issued NBH trajectory, never future observed temperatures. Missing guidance copies exact matched-univariate output. All four frozen physical/blend references remain. Research-only advance requires all fixed gains, no financial promotion, no untouched-validation claim.

evaluation.metric_weighting: Equal UTC target-day weight, equal case weight within each day; RMSE is the square root of day-weighted squared error.
evaluation.point_metric_basis: Raw baseline point forecasts or pretrained/fitted neural medians before quantile calibration.
